claim: Useful tool for Worldbuilding Wars (Wikipedia Military Box Editor)
summary: Wikipedia Military Box Editor is a website that allows you to edit those military boxes you find on War pages. It doesn't take long to make, but it does require some knowledge of how to edit in Wikipedia.
